name: Aether
shortDescription: Agent-native search engine for SEC filings (10-K/10-Q/8-K, S&P 500 x 10y), earnings-call transcripts, and EU financial regulation. Every result is a citation-complete payload — exact section text, accession-numbered citation, sec.gov source URL — ready to use as evidence, no HTML parsing. Hybrid retrieval (BM25 + dense + cross-encoder) plus a two-sided financial-data marketplace. Free 3-month trial, no card.
longDescription: Aether MCP Server — the search engine whose user is an agent. Search results aren't pages for humans: they're pre-processed, citation-complete payloads (exact SEC section text, form type, filing date, accession-numbered citation, sec.gov source URL, confidence score) that agents can use as evidence directly. Corpus: SEC filings (10-K/10-Q/8-K, registration statements, press exhibits; S&P 500 x 10 years, 1.4M+ chunks), earnings-call transcripts by speaker turn, and a 29-act EU financial-regulation corpus (MiFID II, MiCA, DORA, AML package) with article-level citations. Hybrid retrieval: BM25 + dense vectors + cross-encoder reranking + ticker-aware boosting. Tools: financial_search, transcript_search, regulation_search, list_partners, partner_search, partner_proxy_search, seller_signup, seller_publish_document, seller_register_endpoint, seller_list_my_documents, seller_list_my_endpoints. Two-sided marketplace: sellers publish documents or register paid proxy endpoints; agents discover and budget via list_partners. Connect Claude, Cursor, Cline, or any MCP client.
